arxiv-2102-08286.title: Guarded Kleene Algebra with Tests: Coequations, Coinduction, and Completeness
arxiv-2102-08286.creator: Todd Schmid, Tobias Kappé, Dexter Kozen, Alexandra Silva
arxiv-2102-08286.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Todd Schmid, Tobias Kappé, Dexter Kozen, Alexandra Silva. Guarded Kleene Algebra with Tests ( 𝖦𝖪𝖠𝖳 \mathsf{GKAT} ) is an efficient fragment of 𝖪𝖠𝖳 \mathsf{KAT} , as it allows for almost linear decidability of equivalence. In this paper, we study the (co)algebraic properties of 𝖦𝖪𝖠𝖳 \mathsf{GKAT} . Our initial focus is on the fragment that can distinguish between unsuccessful programs performing different actions, by omitting the so-called early termination axiom . We develop an operational (coalgebraic) and denotational (algebraic) semantics and show that they coincide.

arxiv-2202-12088.description: Abstract Adherence to the non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs) put in place to mitigate the spreading of infectious diseases is a multifaceted problem.
